name: GTG-20006
akas: Russian espionage group; Anthropic states "consistent with public reporting linking the actor to Midnight Blizzard"
brief: Automated operations end-to-end via AI-driven workflows — development, infrastructure acquisition, phishing, persistence, C2, and exfiltration. Notably, monitoring AI agents that detected their own malware being flagged by a security product would autonomously modify and rebuild it to evade the new detection. Deployed custom Windows implants, a mobile exploitation kit, a browser-credential stealer, and a phishing platform mimicking government organizations; used device-code phishing, DNS hijacking of hospitality vendors, and WhatsApp account takeovers against Ukrainian/European government, military, diplomatic, and defense targets. Anthropic
